LanguageData.TM_SmallMagicalThruster.label: small magical thruster
LanguageData.TM_SmallMagicalThruster.description: A magofuel thruster that increases gravship range. Draws magofuel through connected mana beacons from reservoirs carried on the same gravship. Has no built-in tank and cannot use mana, chemfuel or astrofuel. Requires a linked grav engine, substructure and an unobstructed exhaust facing outdoors. Fuel is spent when the gravship launches.
